title: Discipline
subtitle: Absences, late arrivals, refusals and reported incidents, then the procedures: hearing, decision, appeal. A report alone never sanctions anyone.

kpi.activeCasesHint: Opened, at hearing or under appeal

report.title: Report something
report.hint: A report tells the federation. It sanctions nobody: only a decided procedure can.

open.title: Open a disciplinary procedure
open.hint: The official is told that a procedure is open, that they will be summoned and that they may appeal.

hearing.title: Set the hearing
hearing.hint: The official is told the date in their space.

decide.title: Decision
decide.hint: The decision is sent to the official and written to the audit log. A suspension that has started takes effect at once; a future one on its date.
decide.refHint: Required for a suspension: the reference of the competent body's decision.
decide.removalWarning: Removal takes the official off designations for good.
decide.affected: {name} holds {n} designations during the sanction: replace them in the calendar.

appeal.title: Appeal
appeal.hint: An appeal keeps the decision from becoming final. The federation then rules again.

close.title: Close the procedure?
close.hint: A closed procedure can no longer be changed.
close.liftWarning: Careful: closing the procedure lifts the suspension and gives the official back their previous status.

empty.incidentsHint: Reported absences, late arrivals and incidents appear here.
empty.casesHint: A procedure is opened from a report or directly for an official.

errors.ref: A suspension needs the decision reference (at least 3 characters).
errors.window: Give the start and end dates; the end cannot come before the start.
errors.unknown_reference: That report does not concern this official.

mine.title: My disciplinary procedures
mine.appealHint: Explain why you dispute the decision.
mine.defendHint: Explain your side before the case is decided; it becomes part of the record.
